_note: KYVO exercise id -> OpenGym3D pack exercise, checked by hand: same body movement and stance (the pack draws no equipment). views: camera order, the first is the default. Every pack exercise is converted, but only these are shown. No KYVO match: bicep_curl (both arms at once), crunch, dumbbell_shoulder_press (standing), high_knees, jumping_jack, overhead_tricep_extension (standing), sumo_squat, superman. Rejected after rendering frame by frame, because they would teach the wrong movement: bent_over_row (one arm pulls, torso nearly upright), front_raise (one arm, raised out to the side), glute_bridge (shoulders float above the floor, arms reach through it), push_up (the chest barely lowers).
